title: Because the Two of Us Can Run at Full Throttle

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Tracen Meet, where the
students choose their own
events to race
in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every year the academy booms with
energy as visitors flood the
campus. In all
that uproar, an unstoppable voice rises
above the rest.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Rrraaaaagh! I wanna go faaaaast!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You know it!
This is the perfect chance for
everyone to see the fruits
of our training!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It seems like lots of debuting students
are
doing the same
1,700-meter turf race that
I chose...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, what was this called again? The
pre... pre-lee...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The preliminaries.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! THAT! Oh, is that you,
Hayahide? Gooood morning!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. I'm glad to see you're in
high spirits, Ticket. A lack of
anxiety
means you can achieve your full potential.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Yep! All thanks to my trainer
here!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right! Let me introduce you to my classmate, Hayahide! She's SUPER smart!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And if she's here, that means... Let's
seeeee...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah-ha! Taishiiin! Get over here, youuu!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Keep your big dumb voice down,
stupid! Everyone's looking!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Sorry, sorry! But I'm so happy to
see you two! Hayahide, I
didn't think you'd
be here yet since your race is in the
afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, I wanted to observe your run.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Awww! Thank youuu! I'm going to give it
my best shot!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And what about you, Taishin? Hold on a
sec—didn't you tell me you
usually skip
these "boring" events?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I was just taking a walk and happened to
pass through. It's irritatingly
noisy though,
so I'm out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No way! You're going home already?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But you have to see me show my stuff in
the raaace! Don't make me
all saaad!
Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, geez, quit crying, you baby!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm still leaving though. Later.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nooo! TAISHIIIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Worry not, Ticket. Taishin went in the
direction of the spectator
stands.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, really?! T-T-Taishiiin! I'm SO touched by your super awkward friendship!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the heartwarming scene comes to an
end, the time for Winning
Ticket to run
arrives at long last.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Traaaineeer! It's time! I'm finally
racing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You've been such a great trainer to stick
with me. I... I could just...
Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! I need to tell you something
before I start crying!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well... I don't think I've ever inspired
anyone with my running.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But still!
I met you and learned a lot from
our training. So, now... now
I...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nnngaaah! The words aren't comiiiiing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sorry!
I'll just have to show you in the race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ka-chak!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The 1,700-meter turf begins! But what
kind of show will these
potential stars give
us?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket pulls out ahead! It's a
strong, yet controlled, pace!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (Hm? Huh?! What is this? It's so weird!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(Is it 'cause we trained together all that
time? Did I learn this from all
the talking
we did every day?)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(Stay calm and watch your surroundings.
Think about pacing. Stay at your own
speed...
It's like I can hear Trainer's voice
in my head.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Her running's different. When did
she learn how to do that...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating! Heh,
you've met a fine trainer,
Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (I understand... I see it, Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's the stretch! This is it,
right?! Time for
full poweeeeer!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket's speeding up! She's
leaving everyone behind!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's going! She's really moving! What an
incredible burst of speed!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Urrraaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
FINISH! Winning Ticket takes first! What a
stunning victory!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thanks for cheering for me, everyooone!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Ticket! You were
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, thank you, thank yooou! I'm so
HAPPYYY!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll return the favor...
Someday I'll be an
Umamusume who inspires
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I wanna vow to everyone
here, as well as the trainer who
taught me
how to run!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I promise... to become a Derby
champiooon!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unlike at the tryouts, not one person
doubts her words now.
